Update the local SPI inventory cache

Source: R/spi-inventory-cache.R
spi_update_inventory.Rd

Forces a fresh crawl of the World Bank SPI repository for the specified version and writes the result to the on-disk inventory cache. Useful when the remote repository has been updated and you want to refresh before the automatic 30-day TTL expires.

spi_update_inventory(version = "master")

Arguments

version

Character. Branch name in the SPI repository. Defaults to "master" (latest stable). Use spi_versions() to list all available branches.

Value

The updated inventory data.table, invisibly. Each row represents one file in the SPI repository, with columns:

path

Relative file path within the repository.

type

GitHub object type: "blob" (file) or "tree" (directory).

size

File size in bytes (NA for directories).

category

"raw", "output", or "misc".

pillar

Integer 1–5, or NA.

dimension

Character "P.D" (e.g. "4.1"), or NA.

Details

For reproducible workflows, call spi_update_inventory() explicitly before distributing analysis code rather than relying on the automatic 30-day TTL refresh of the internal cache.

Development status

This function depends on the github-tree-crawler milestone. Calling it on the current development build will error with class "spi_not_implemented".

See also

spi_clear_inventory(), spi_versions()

Other spi-inventory-cache: spi_clear_inventory()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Refresh the default version
spi_update_inventory()

# Refresh a specific version
spi_update_inventory(version = "SPI2023")
} # }
